purpose: Monochrome emissive colour texture for runtime cyan/amber/violet plasma sphere
prompt: Create a production-ready seamless equirectangular 2:1 grayscale emissive plasma texture map. Bright branching electric arcs, tangled luminous filaments and molten wisps flow over charcoal voids. Edge-to-edge texture only: no orb silhouette, no hardware, no baked directional lighting, no text. Horizontal edges should join for wrapping around a sphere. Strong contrast with fine detail and some broad turbulent structure. The texture will be tinted cyan, amber or violet by the game shader.
prompt_note: Recorded reconstruction of the generation brief; the exact tool request is in the session image-generation call.
technical_conversion: Blender resized to 2048x1024 and packed CM alpha=0, ADD=(1,1,0,0), NG=(0.5,0.5,1,0); SEUT generated DDS. Technical maps use Non-Color data.
